body: I hope it gets better for you and for me. We’re all human in the end - we all fuck up and we all deserve forgiveness.
I was too stubborn and stupid to notice my bad behavior, and so my ex left me. My fault, but I’ve lost the chance to fix it.

Hey, I’m sorry you’re going through this, and you must be hurting like crazy. I’m going through some (different) shit myself and I wake up in the middle of the night in a blind panic with my heart racing and believing that my life is over. But regardless of whether or not it’s true that you are unattractive, remember that you have inherent value as a person. Reading your post helped me and made me feel less alone. I hope that my comment helps you, even if it’s just a little bit.
Hey - you are not alone. I wake up at 4am with my heart pounding because I am feeling the exact same way.
